welcome.title: Welcome to Grace International Sydney
welcome.subtitle: Where dreams meet opportunities in the Harbor City.

teams.name: Simrita Ranjitkar
teams.description: Simrita Ranjitkar serves as the Executive Director and Registered Migration Agent at Grace International Sydney. She leads with expertise in Australian immigration and education services, guiding international students with professionalism and care. Her dedication ensures seamless support throughout the migration process, making Grace International a trusted destination for clients.

teams.name: Sirat Teji
teams.description: Sirat Teji is a Registered Migration Agent at Grace International Sydney, specializing in Australian immigration services. With in-depth knowledge of visa processes and regulations, she provides personalized guidance to clients. Her commitment to excellence ensures reliable support for individuals pursuing education, career, or settlement opportunities in Australia.

teams.name: Liya Varkey
teams.description: Liya Varkey is a Registered Migration Agent at Grace International Sydney, offering expert guidance on Australian visa and migration matters. Known for her professionalism and attention to detail, she supports clients through every step of the process, ensuring a smooth and informed journey toward their education and migration goals.

teams.name: Nirajan Tamrakar
teams.description: Nirajan Tamrakar is the Director of Grace International Strathfield, leading the branch with a focus on student success and client satisfaction. With strong expertise in international education and migration services, he ensures high-quality support and personalized solutions for students and migrants pursuing opportunities in Australia.

teams.name: Kapil Burlakoti
teams.position: Business Development Associates/ Senior Education Consultant
